analysis.headline: Strongest recent run
analysis.body: Six of eleven current Set 7–11 paintings received explicit praise: all three Set 8 Fervor cards, The Sky Falls In, Salamander-hide Mantle, and Anoint with Embers. Earlier favorites include Goblin Cutter, Cinderfall and the firepot thrower. Energy, varied fire/storm magic, and distinctive creatures are working.

analysis.headline: Most consistent established identity
analysis.body: The Set 6 review broadly liked the Dominion paintings, with a local blade correction for Court Assassin. Court Informant, Bone Harvester, Withering Hex and the Ashwing studies anchor the longer history. Four of twelve recent cards received explicit praise. Courtly atmosphere and eerie, purposeful activity are strong; Night Embassy shows glamour alone is not enough.

analysis.headline: High ceiling; uneven execution
analysis.body: Borrowed Will is an explicit strong favorite. The inventor scene, Underbridge Vaporwright, Engine at Rest and practical craft also stand out. Recent stopping/ice spells needed clearer actions, and Harmonic Burst is final but explicitly not a favorite. Vary mechanisms and make the magical idea readable; preserve the existing limit on sound themes.

analysis.headline: Quiet care and warm light work
analysis.body: The Still Flame, Sunmane Lancer, Rite of Stillness and Last Light in the Barracks are positive anchors. Earlier busy group scenes, waxy faces and staged poses drew corrections. Recent final approvals are encouraging, but sparse specific praise makes a numerical placement unreliable.

analysis.headline: Creature and woodland promise
analysis.body: The Alderkin Elder is explicitly liked in the recent cards; earlier wolves, Thornbrake and living-tree studies also work. Casting, water rendering and cartoonish anatomy have needed correction. Creature studies without an assigned alignment are kept in Unassigned rather than silently counted as Genesis.

analysis.headline: Favorites outside the five alignments
analysis.body: Copper Hound is a recent standout and Buckling Recruit is liked. The Cobalt Rapier, Roof Glider and Dawnsail show strong taste signals, but not every creature or equipment study has a settled alignment. Bellframe Construct was rejected and deleted.
